text_blocks.snippet: A femoral neck fracture, a break in the upper part of the thigh bone (femur) near the hip joint, typically presents with pain in the groin or hip area that worsens with weight-bearing and hip rotation. Other common symptoms include an inability to stand or walk, a shortened and externally rotated leg, and sometimes radiating pain down to the knee.
